posts.title: Creating a Google Cloud Run Function to Retrieve data from an API and store it in Google Cloud Storage
posts.description: Updated: 20261028 Introduction This tutorial introduces Google Cloud Run Functions. Google Cloud Run functions (formerly Google Cloud Functions) are a serverless, event-driven compute service that allows you to deploy small, single-purpose code snippets without managing underlying infrastructure. Cloud Functions automatically scale based on traffic and are triggered by HTTP requests or cloud event
